Como cada número foi calculado, de onde: How each number was calculated, where it comes from and with what grade:
Condições de partida, professores por es: Starting conditions, pupils per teacher, electricity, internet, mobile data, solar energy and salaries come from country data (UIS, World Bank, ITU, UNICEF, ILOSTAT), with source and grade on each line. The other prices are still tool reference values (grade C), adjusted to the country price level when they are local services.
Custo econômico, desembolso novo e o que: Economic cost, new spending and what already exists
Ferramenta pública ou incluída numa plat: Public tool, or one included in a platform the network already pays for: no licence. UNESCO guidance on generative AI in education (2023) suggests 13 as the minimum age for direct use; that is why the default is 0% in the early childhood, literacy, inclusive, multilingual and well-being challenges, which mainly serve younger children. Adjust if your population is 13 or older.
Grau B: salário oficial do país (ILOSTAT: Grade B: official country salary (ILOSTAT) for the profile; the number of people and the allocation are tool conventions (grade C), editable.
Grau C: valor de referência da ferrament: Grade C: tool reference value, still without a country source; the methodology says where it comes from and what would replace it.
Grau do preço: {g}; quantidades e parâme: Price grade: {g}; quantities and parameters without their own source are tool conventions (grade C).
locais × banda por local (a maior entre: sites × bandwidth per site (the larger of the minimum bandwidth and simultaneous students × Mbps) × months × price per Mbps
Nesta prioridade, as viagens vêm com 0%,: In this priority, travel defaults to 0%, because the lines already include visits, travel, in-person meetings, material distribution and delivery to sites; use the percentage only for travel not in those lines.
novos locais sem energia × energia por l: new sites without electricity × energy per site per day ÷ (solar output per kW × (1 − losses)) × cost per installed kW
O custo econômico soma tudo o que o plan: The economic cost adds up everything the plan uses. New spending removes from it the salaries of people marked as existing employees; that part is already paid by another budget, but it is a real cost of the plan.
Os números sugeridos vêm de dados do paí: The suggested numbers come from country data: enrolment (World Bank), pupils per teacher and schools with electricity and internet (UNESCO UIS) and children with disabilities (UNICEF). Each field states the source, year and grade; adjust them to your network.
parte das matrículas do país (Banco Mund: share of country enrolment (World Bank), grade C
Piloto sugerido: um ano letivo (9 meses): Suggested pilot: one school year (9 months) at 5% of sites, with at least {min} (or all, if the network is smaller) and at most {max} sites, enough for an evaluation with a comparison group. If you change the reach, your value applies.
Preço comercial do kWh do país no Doing: Commercial price per kWh in the country from Doing Business 2019 (World Bank), updated for country inflation and converted at the current exchange rate; replace it with the utility tariff.
Preço do GB = preço mensal da cesta de d: Price per GB = monthly price of the ITU mobile-data basket in the country ÷ basket allowance.
Preço por Mbps = preço mensal da cesta d: Price per Mbps = monthly price of the ITU fixed-broadband basket in the country ÷ basket speed; the suggested minimum bandwidth is the basket speed, so each site pays for at least one plan. It is a residential plan, a floor for a school plan.
Produção solar por kW instalado (kWh por: Solar output per installed kW (kWh per day)
uma revisão antes do primeiro uso e outr: one review before first use and another of the scale-up contract before implementation (half the effort with an open licence)
Vale também para ferramentas públicas e: This also applies to public and open tools: the terms of use, the processing of children’s data and the model licence need review.
A produção solar por kW instalado vem do: The solar output per installed kW comes from the country photovoltaic potential (World Bank/ESMAP). The energy per site per day is a convention: with AI, about 20 devices of 50 W for 6 hours; without AI, lighting and the teacher’s equipment.
A dificuldade funcional medida pelo UNIC: The functional difficulty measured by UNICEF includes learning, attention and emotional difficulties that do not call for equipment; the share that needs glasses, hearing aids, wheelchairs or alternative communication is a tool convention (grade C), pending the basket by product type.
Estudantes com deficiência que precisam: Students with disabilities who need equipment (%)
estudantes e professores nos locais liga: students and teachers at grid-connected sites × kWh per person per month × months × price per kWh
Estudantes que usam dispositivo neste de: Students who use a device in this challenge (%)
No ensino em casa e na modalidade online: In home learning and online delivery, one device per student. In early childhood education, the suggestion is that only the educator uses a device (0% of students); adjust the share to the screen time foreseen in your pedagogical design.
novos estudantes com deficiência × parte: new students with disabilities × share needing equipment × equipment price
Numa assinatura, suporte e atualizações: In a subscription, support and updates are already in the price (0%); use about 15% per year only for a perpetual licence installed by the network.
O mesmo preço nas duas alternativas: a p: The same price in both alternatives: the platform is the same; what AI adds is in category 4.3.
Os dispositivos em uso seguem a linha de: Devices in use follow the student devices line (students per device; one per student in home learning and online) and teachers without a device.
percentual sobre o consumo de tokens ou: percentage of token consumption or GPU hours
Preço comercial do kWh do país no Doing: Commercial price per kWh in the country from Doing Business 2019 (World Bank), updated for country inflation and converted at the current exchange rate (without country data, the median of the country IMF group); replace it with the utility tariff. Sites receiving a solar system and students learning at home are not included.
quebra por ano (%) × investimento acumul: yearly breakage (%) × cumulative investment in student and teacher devices (price with taxes) × years
Só quando a rede opera a aplicação (cons: Only when the network operates the application (token consumption or its own GPUs). In a ready-made product, the filter comes in the price: check in the contract that it is active and configured for minors.
